title: HPRTAS i* Strategic Rationale models
baseline: the workshop goal model of the referral pathway (材料/goalModel.txt and goalDiagram (1).png, 12 Oct 2026)
note: One page per actor - four pages, one for each actor of the workshop goal model. An element's `deps` list names the SD dependencies it accounts for, so every dependency in sd-hprtas.json has a rationale here and every reference resolves back. Link types are the i* ones: `means-end` (a means to an end, including the alternative routes to the same goal), `decomposition` (with `and` / `or`, the parts of a task or goal), `neededby` (a resource a task needs), and the contribution links `make`, `help`, `some+`, `unknown`, `some-`, `hurt`, `break`. The diagnostic decomposition is the one the workshop goal model draws: the doctor's diagnosis breaks into reviewing the patient's history, performing clinical appraisal, and assessing whether admission is needed, all AND; the determination of the cancer type and site is reached with the doctor's own expertise or by the specialist's review of the test results, both means-end alternatives.
